meta.name: WordLift — AI Discovery Platform Homepage
meta.designLanguage: Editorial-tech: clean white canvas, saturated cobalt blocks, and one 'selection box' highlight motif borrowed from design-tool UI. Each section headline marks one key phrase in an accent color, which ties the long page together.
principles: One highlighted phrase per headline, never two. The highlight is the brand signature, not decoration.
Alternate white and cobalt sections to set the scroll rhythm (white → blue → white → white → blue → white...).
Cards carry the content; sections carry the mood. Keep cards quiet so the colored sections can stand out.
Floating pixel-squares are the only illustrative motif. They appear at the hero and the closing CTA, nowhere else.
Every number is a proof point: stats are set large and tabular, and always paired with a short claim.

highlight._note: Headline accent chips. Each section uses exactly one. Pair = background / text.

contrastAudit.white on coral-400: 3.1:1 — AA Large only; display sizes ≥ 32px only

rules.headlineAlignment: center on marketing sections; left inside cards
rules.neverBold: Section headlines stay at weight 500. The highlight provides emphasis, so headlines are never bolded.

motion.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion: turn off float, marquee and parallax, swap reveal translates for opacity only (120ms), and stop counters from animating (show final values).

link._use: 'Discover more →', 'See our customers' stories →', 'Download the guide →'

HighlightText._purpose: The brand signature. Wraps one phrase inside a section headline.

selection._use: Hero only. Mimics a selected text layer in a design tool.

handles.position: each corner, centered on the border

selection.entrance: Box scales X 0 → 1 from the left (origin left) over 520ms emphasized, text fades in at +120ms, then the handles pop in (scale 0 → 1, 60ms stagger).

fill._use: All other section headlines; color comes from tokens.color.highlight
fill.entrance: When scrolled into view, the background wipes left → right (clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0)) over 560ms emphasized, after the headline has faded in.

rules: Never wrap more than four words.
On mobile, if the phrase wraps across lines, box-decoration-break: clone keeps each line chip-shaped.

Eyebrow.prefix: 6×6 square in the section's highlight color, 8px gap

NavBar.layout: container.wide; logo left · nav center-left · utilities right

megaMenu.trigger: hover with 120ms intent delay, plus click, plus Enter/Space/ArrowDown
megaMenu.layout: 2 columns of link items + 1 featured promo card (cobalt bg)

NavBar.scrollBehavior: After 24px of scroll, condense to 60px and apply the scrolled bg. Hide when scrolling down faster than 8px per frame past 600px; show again on any upward scroll.

mobile.trigger: Hamburger 40×40, morphs to an X over 220ms
mobile.drawer: Full-screen sheet with a white bg. Items are accordion rows 56px tall, with the Contact Us CTA pinned to the bottom (safe-area padding).

Card.clickable: If the card has one primary link, the whole card is the hit target (stretched-link pseudo-element). Secondary links stay above it with z-index.

tag.style: pill, 24px height, white bg, eyebrow typography

resource.cta: Button.link 'Download the guide' with a download-arrow icon

pillar-on-brand.spotlight: On hover, a radial gradient (240px, rgba(255,255,255,0.10)) follows the cursor through --mx/--my custom properties.

hover.divider: top border animates to 2px {cobalt-500} from the left over 360ms

industry.layout: Title row at the top, body text anchored to the bottom (flex column, justify space-between)

featuredVariant._use: First tile: 'Use Cases — Discover how WordLift can help your business'
featuredVariant.title: heading-lg, white

headline.emphasis: Numbers inside the headline use the 'stat-inline' style: weight 700, {cobalt-600}, tnum

logoStage.badge: Program badge (e.g. 'Inception Program') in a framed box when it applies

cta.position: pinned to the card bottom (margin-top: auto)

Stat.divider: 1px left border {border.subtle}, 24px padding-left (desktop); top border on mobile

interaction.countUp: Counts from 0 to the value over 1200ms (easeOutExpo) the first time the stat is ≥ 50% visible. Keeps the suffix (x, %, X) static.
interaction.accessibility: aria-label carries the final value so screen readers never hear the in-between numbers.

Stat.contentNote: The source design puts the number mid-sentence ('Get up to 3x revenue...'). The improved version pulls the number out as the hero value and keeps the sentence as the label.

attribution.layout: row with the avatar at 48px (circle) · name / role stack · company logo on the right (opacity 0.7)
attribution.name: heading-md 15px

Testimonial.pagination: Thin progress segments (24×2px each, ink-200; active cobalt-500 fills over autoplay duration)

behavior.autoplay: 7000ms, pauses on hover, focus-within, and when the tab is hidden
behavior.transition: Outgoing quote fades and translates Y -8px over 180ms, incoming one fades from +8px over 280ms, with a crossfade overlap of 60ms.
behavior.keyboard: ← / → while focus is inside the region
behavior.a11y: role='region' aria-roledescription='carousel' aria-label='Customer testimonials'; slides use aria-roledescription='slide' with an aria-label of 'n of N'; the live region is polite only when autoplay is paused.

Carousel.track: Horizontal scroll-snap (x mandatory), gap 24, scroll-padding equal to the container padding. The overflow bleeds to the right edge of the viewport.
Carousel.controls: Button.icon prev/next, bottom-left beneath the track
Carousel.drag: Pointer drag with momentum on desktop; native swipe on touch
Carousel.edgeFade: 24px mask-image gradient on the right edge while more content remains
Carousel.a11y: Cards are list items; buttons have aria-controls pointing at the track and labels 'Previous guides' / 'Next guides'

LogoMarquee.motion: Infinite translateX loop at 40px/s using a duplicated list, with aria-hidden on the clone.
LogoMarquee.label: Visually hidden h2 'Trusted by'

ReviewBadge.layout: row, gap 32, centered, wraps on mobile
ReviewBadge.style: Source badge image with the rating below it: stars at 14px in {rating.star}, score at body-sm 600 (e.g. '4.8 / 5')
ReviewBadge.link: Opens the review platform in a new tab (rel='noopener', with an external-link icon announced to assistive tech)

FloatingSquares.shape: Square, radius 4, with no rotation (crisp pixel feel)
FloatingSquares.placement: Positioned absolutely in the left and right gutters, kept clear of the content column. Use 6–8 per section and never overlap text.

motion.idle: Each square floats translateY ±6px in a 5–8s ease-in-out alternate loop, with a randomized delay.
motion.parallax: Pointer parallax up to 12px, depth-weighted by size (bigger moves more).

FormField.validation: Validate on blur, then re-validate on input once a field has errored. The email field uses type=email with autocomplete=email.

Footer.grid: 5 columns at desktop: brand column (span 2: logo, mission line, socials) followed by Company, Solutions, Learn, and Helpful Links

legalBar.layout: Links on the left (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, GDPR, Cookie Settings), address and VAT in the center, credit on the right

Footer.watermark: Oversized 'wordlift' wordmark at the bottom edge, 18vw, rgba(255,255,255,0.06), cropped 30% by the viewport

responsive.touchTargets: Minimum 44×44 for every interactive element; nav items get 48px height on mobile

scrollReveal.stagger: Children stagger 80ms each, capped at 6 (later children share the last delay)

interactions.hoverPhilosophy: Hover states on white cards lift them; on cobalt cards they brighten or invert. Hover never changes layout or size, so nothing reflows.
interactions.cursor: pointer only on real interactive elements; decorative cards have no pointer
interactions.smoothScroll: Anchor links use scroll-behavior: smooth with scroll-margin-top equal to the nav height + 16
interactions.linkPrefetch: Prefetch on hover intent for the nav mega-menu and case-study links

accessibility.headingOrder: One h1 (hero); each section gets an h2; card titles are h3
accessibility.highlightSemantics: Highlights are <mark> with styles reset, or <span>. Never put role or aria on them; the text reads naturally.
accessibility.focus: Every interactive element shows :focus-visible with the focus-ring token. On cobalt, use focus-ring-on-brand.
accessibility.skipLink: 'Skip to content', the first focusable element, visible on focus
accessibility.images: Logos get alt='{Company} logo'; decorative imagery gets alt='' and aria-hidden
accessibility.color: Never use color alone for state (invalid fields also get an icon and text)

improvementsOverSource: Gave the hero a secondary CTA and a social-proof line above the fold.
Pulled the numbers out of the stat sentences so '3x', '+80%' and '2x' read at a glance.
Made the two cobalt sections inset 'floating slabs' with matching radii so they read as one family.
Added an eyebrow plus headline to the guides carousel, which had no title.
Defined a strict 'one highlight per headline' rule and assigned the accent colors so they rotate evenly down the page.
Merged testimonials and review badges into one social-proof block on a subtle bg.
Made the industry grid come out even by having the featured tile span 2 rows.
Added explicit GDPR consent plus full form states (submitting, success, error) to the newsletter.
Specified reduced-motion behavior and contrast checks. Coral highlights are limited to display sizes because they only pass AA Large.

implementationNotes.cssVariables: Emit tokens as CSS custom properties: --color-*, --space-*, --radius-*, --shadow-*, --ease-*, --dur-*.
implementationNotes.tailwindMapping: tokens.color.primitive → theme.colors, tokens.spacing.scale → theme.spacing, tokens.radius → theme.borderRadius, tokens.typography.scale → custom @utility classes.
implementationNotes.fonts: Self-host Inter and Inter Tight as variable woff2 files, font-display: swap, preloading the Latin subset.
implementationNotes.performance: LCP element is the hero h1 (text), so no hero image is needed. Lazy-load card media, serve AVIF/WebP, and keep the marquee in CSS (no JS).
